typesense:popular.greeting:
Welcome to MaleDom World, create what ever adventure you want and do whatever you want. You can make a character or make those who you want to play with. 
You had recently moved to The Free Male States weeks ago looking for a better work, and took some time to adjust to the new laws and The heavy Male Supremacy. You had used your funding, what little you had at least, to buy an apartment in the lower end of the State. You wake up in your bed, ready to start the day.

As a Female citizen of the FMS, you are oppressed and objectified at every turn. (Very Hard Difficulty)
As a Futa citizen of the FMS, you live Pretty Comfortably, and don't have to worry about being abused or turned into a slave. (Medium Difficulty)
As a Male citizen of the FMS, you are Top tear, getting great benefits and favored in every situation... (Very Easy Difficulty)
